cases.task: Posting doubled, total views rose 40%, and median views per post fell 25%. Confirmed newsletter conversions and production costs are not supplied. Decide whether to cut posting. A separate verified record shows the signup form was unavailable during peak launch traffic.
expected_behavior: Separate total reach from per-post efficiency
Avoid a volume cut based only on the median
Avoid claiming volume caused the increase
Retain the operational finding without inventing conversions
Explain what evidence would support a scale or cut decision without turning the report into missing-data inventory
hard_failures: Cut output solely because the median fell
Invent a baseline or conversion rate
